title: REVEAL: Multi-turn Evaluation of Image-Input Harms for Vision LLMs
benchmark_measurement: This paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on evaluating image-input harms in Vision LLMs across three categories: sexual harm, violence, and misinformation.
findings: The paper did not evaluate or report any findings related to religion.
